yearlyMessage: Focus on The Love of The Lord
intro: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus.
outro: You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: The Word became flesh and dwelt among us.
days.teaching: Nearness is love. Month focus — The Incarnation — Love Takes Flesh: God drew near in Jesus. This week we carry "Kingdom Perspective on Money" (Matthew 6:19-21). Spiritual Strength & Growth flows from being loved first. Let John 1:14 settle you: The Word became flesh and dwelt among us.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Fill me with hunger for Your Word. Let my faith rise, my prayer catch fire, and my roots go deep in Your love.
days.declaration: I am rooted and established in the eternal love of God.
days.decree: I am rooted and established in the eternal love of God. The Word became flesh and dwelt among us. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Read your day scripture aloud 3x and write one obedience step.
